name: Ring cameras
summary: Tells your notice agent when a Ring camera sees motion or a doorbell is pressed, with a still picture, and lets your agents look at your cameras when you ask: the latest picture, a live picture, a short clip, a recorded clip and the recent event history. Read-only.

settings.label: Ring account email
settings.help: The email address of the Ring account that owns the cameras. It is sent to Ring once, when the account is linked.

settings.label: Public address of this Maestro
settings.help: The https address Ring can reach from the internet, for example https://maestro.example.com (no path). Used to show the four addresses to enter in Ring's developer console.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: Used for the times in notices and for the day folders of pictures, for example Europe/London. An unknown zone falls back to UTC.

settings.label: Houses
settings.help: Optional. Groups cameras by a word in their name, for example: House A: front, back; House B: garage. Shown in notices.

settings.label: Pictures size limit (MB)
settings.help: The oldest pictures are removed first when the folder grows past this.

settings.label: Clips size limit (MB)
settings.help: The oldest clips are removed first when the folder grows past this.

settings.label: Recognize faces
settings.help: Needs a face recognizer running on this computer. Pictures are only ever sent to the address below, and only if it is this computer.

settings.label: Face recognizer address
settings.help: Only http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost is accepted.

settings.label: Notice unknown faces seen before
settings.help: Only with face recognition on: tells you when an unknown face has been seen on earlier visits.

docs.revoke: Remove the connection in the Ring app (the list of connected apps), or delete the private app in Ring's developer console.
